hollow.instructions: At least one #[test] in this file cannot fail, no matter how the code under test behaves.

criteria.true: A test has assertion_count 0, or every one of its assertions is counted in self_comparing_assertions, or all of its assertions sit inside a loop whose resolved_element_count is 0
criteria.false: Every test reaches at least one assertion that compares an output of the code under test against a separately written expected value
